allot.subject: Monitoring Agency Report
allot.text: Submission of Monitoring Agency Report(s) on utilization of IPO, Pre-IPO Placement and Rights Issue Proceeds for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.

allot.subject: Monitoring Agency Report
allot.text: Submission of Monitoring Agency Report(s) on Utilization of IPO, Pre-IPO Placement and Rights Issue Proceeds for the quarter ended December 31, 2025

allot.subject: Monitoring Agency Report
allot.text: Exicom has submitted the Monitoring Agency Report(s) on utilization of proceeds raised from Initial Public Offer ("IPO") and Pre-IPO Private Placement for the quarter ended September 30, 2025 and from Rights issue for the period commenced from July 31, 2025 to September 30, 2025.

allot.subject: ESOP/ESOS/ESPS
allot.text: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cancellation of   Options granted under Exicom Tele-Systems Limited Employees Stock Option Scheme 2023 & Exicom Tele-Systems Limited Employees Stock Option Scheme 2025, respectively.

allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2025, titled "Press Release - Exicom Successfully Concludes Rights Issue; Reinforces Promoter Confidence and Strategic Growth Agenda".

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Rights Issue Committee  has approved  the allotment of Equity Shares on Rights basis .

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about copy of letter of offer dated July 01, 2025 for Rights Issue

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited has informed the Exchange that Rights Issue committee of the Board of Directors at its meeting held on July 01, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 3 : 20, i.e 3 Equity Shares for every 20 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 143 per share.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding receipt of In-Principle Approval from National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) and BSE Limited (BSE) in respect of proposed Rights Issue.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about outcome of Board Meeting held on June 25, 2025

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: We wish to inform you that the Board of Directors (Board) of Exicom Tele-Systems Limited (Company), at its meeting held today i.e. Wednesday, June 25, 2025, has considered and approved funds raised through Rights issue and other items.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 19515 equity shares against the stock options exercised under Exicom Tele-Systems Limited Employees Stock Option Scheme 2023
